newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Nice rated strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Nice rated strong buy.

text.p: Solid Financial Markets on Thursday issued a "strong buy" recommendation for Nice Systems and set a 12-month price target of $48-$52 a share.

A deal to acquire Dees Communications of Canada, cooperation agreements with international telecommunications companies and the $97 million raised from a public offering this month will enable Nice to expand in the rapidly growing call centre market, Solid said in a report.
Solid said it believes the Israeli company will enter into other joint ventures and make further strategic acquisitions.
Solid estimates Nice will earn $1.29 a share in 1997 and $1.76 in 1998 against $0.76 in 1996.

These estimates are conservative, Solid said, noting that Nice could experience some delays as it penetrates the call centre market. But Solid said it believes Nice will become a major player in this market.
Nice provides systems for logging and monitoring voice, data and fax.
